terms.grammar: subjunctive of wish; vortant is the old spelling of vertant; often with quod agās

phrases.latin: Dī bene vortant quod agās; pedetemptim tamen.
phrases.english: Good luck with what you’re doing; but step by step.
Safe journey, and good luck with it.

phrases.latin: Dī vortant bene quod agās. — Valē. — Et tū bene valē.
phrases.english: Good luck with what you’re doing. — Goodbye. — Goodbye to you too.
